newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates surge on funds shortage.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates surge on funds shortage.

text.p: Pakistani money rates soared on Monday amid a persistent shortage of funds and dealers said rates would remain firm on Tuesday as no major inflow was expected.
Overnight funds were traded at 17 percent throughout the day but some amounts changed hands at 18 percent, a dealer at KASB & Co said.
The dealer said overnight trading was dull and most of the day's trading was in one-month funds offered at 16 percent.
